# Filevora

Navigation index for coding agents. This is not a capability claim. Trust `docs/agents/capabilities.json` and the tests.

- [README](README.md)
- [Install](docs/agents/install.md)
- [Decision guide](docs/agents/decision-guide.md)
- [Troubleshooting](docs/agents/troubleshooting.md)
- [Verification](docs/agents/verification.md)
- [Capabilities](docs/agents/capabilities.json) — versioned manifest of exports, HTTP routes, env vars, error codes, and the progress event. `filevora manifest --json` and `import { readManifest } from 'filevora/manifest'`. `filevora mcp` exposes it over stdio with no extra dependency.
- [Manifest](docs/agents/manifest.md)
- [Init](docs/agents/init.md) — `filevora init --json --dry-run` detects Express, Fastify, Hono, Next.js, or Node and writes handler, client, and env files. It does not overwrite without `--force`.
- [Doctor](docs/agents/doctor.md) — `filevora doctor --json` checks config, mode, storage, Redis, the database, ffmpeg, the scanner, and webhooks. `health: true` on the HTTP handler serves the same report.
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md) — no `FILEVORA_DATABASE_URL` is lite mode; a URL selects stored mode. Schemes: `postgres://`, `postgresql://`, `mysql://`, `mariadb://`, `sqlite://` or a file path. Migrate creates only `filevora_assets` and `filevora_asset_versions`. `POST /assets/from-url` imports an http(s) URL. The SDK sniffs the bytes and blocks private and metadata addresses.
- Upload safety: optional `FILEVORA_MALWARE_SCAN=clamav` after the original is stored and before encoding. `FILEVORA_EXIF_STRIP=gps` (default) drops location metadata from image versions. `FILEVORA_TYPE_MAX_BYTES` limits size by sniffed type.
- [Testing](docs/agents/testing.md) — `filevora/testing` runs filesystem lite mode with synchronous processing. No Redis or S3.
- [Retention](docs/agents/retention.md) — `FILES_RETENTION_*` and `FILES_UNUSED_RETENTION_DAYS`. Stored mode keeps `last_accessed_at` on the asset row. Lite mode keeps it on the asset card and falls back to creation time. Cleanup also removes old orphans.
- [Webhooks](docs/agents/webhooks.md) — optional signed completion webhooks. The body matches the terminal SSE event. Targets use the URL-import SSRF checks. Localhost needs `FILES_WEBHOOKS_ALLOW_LOOPBACK`.
- [Transform](docs/agents/transform.md) — `POST /files/:assetId/transform` with one config object. `replace` defaults to true. Progress events share `phase`, `percentage`, `etaMs`, and a terminal `versions` list.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md)
- [Security](docs/security.md)
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)
- [Agents](AGENTS.md)
